# Global commands

Top-level commands

## commands

Print the command tree as JSON (for agent discovery).

```text
splunkctl commands [OPTIONS]
```

## completion

Print shell completion script for bash, zsh, or fish.

```text
splunkctl completion [OPTIONS] {bash|zsh|fish}
```

## doctor

Check connection, auth, server health, and user permissions.

```text
splunkctl doctor [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--strict` | flag | false | Treat warnings as failures (exit 1). |

## info

Show Splunk server info.

```text
splunkctl info [OPTIONS]
```
